title: Head Facing East or South
description: Sleeping with your head towards South or East aligns body magnetic forces with planetary electromagnetic fields, promoting deep restorative sleep and spiritual calm.
guidelines: Head facing South promotes longevity and peaceful sleep.
Head facing East boosts memory, concentration, and spiritual clarity.
Avoid sleeping with head facing North as Earth's magnetic north repels body iron fields.

title: Ishan Kona (North-East Corner)
description: The North-East direction is known as Ishan Kona, governed by cosmic energy. Placing your home temple here invites divine peace and prosperity.
guidelines: Idols should face East or North during prayer.
Keep Mandir elevated off floor level.
